issues.on_page: p2 Statement of Activities: row 'TIF', Charges for Services column 616,018; p4 funds Taxes 3,903,108
issues.issue: Split is supported, but only by subtraction under evidence-standard rule 3. Checked: p2 general-receipt tax lines (1,334,798 + 139,649 + 1,255,882 + 54,535 + 461,799 + 40,427 = 3,287,090) + 616,018 = 3,903,108 exactly. Every other governmental receipt ties between p2 and p4 (intergovernmental 699,955; interest 19,828; operating 119,449 + capital 360,613 grants = 480,062; total 7,451,598), and the funds' charges for services tie per fund to p2 without TIF (General 385,980 = 226,979 + 136,976 + 22,025; Other Governmental 107,095 = public safety 107,095; Street 4,171; Lottery 1,851,399). So the 616,018 has to sit in the funds' Taxes line (inside Other Governmental Funds Taxes 662,545), and TIF counts as property tax increment. Limits: the report prints TIF as a program 'charge', not as a tax, and no page prints 'Taxes includes TIF'. FY2023 left the same situation unsplit (3,148,966 'taxes' remainder) because its statements differ by $1, so the two years are categorized differently. That difference follows from the exact-reconciliation rule; it is not an extraction error. The label 'TIF' will be renamed 'TIF Proceeds' by user_rules (2026-11-06). The per-fund detail line Other Governmental Funds Taxes 662,545 stays unlabeled, so detail and statement lines are categorized differently.
Mixed label (in lieu + other tax) with no printed breakdown; In Lieu of Tax is defensible but part may be other taxes (already marked review)
No line labelled cash total is printed; ending_cash takes 'Total assets', which holds only cash lines. Under the 2026-11-06 ruling (cash is never derived) this is borderline. beginning_cash is null.
